summary: UI/UX Improvements Testing - All 7 tasks verified and working correctly. Airport IATA search, 24-hour validation, 'Starts from' pricing, 'Standard Class' rename, colored icons outside inputs, phone input with country selector, and new hero image all functioning as expected.

task_1_airport_iata_search: Type 'LHR' shows London Heathrow Airport with blue IATA badge
Type 'London' shows 5 London airports (LHR, LGW, STN, LTN, LCY) with badges
Type 'JFK' shows John F. Kennedy International Airport
Airport results display with IATA code badge and airplane icon
task_2_24hr_validation: Setting today's date with current time shows error 'Pick-up must be at least 24 hours in advance.'
Error displays in red warning box with warning icon
Continue button disabled when 24hr validation fails
Error disappears when selecting date 3+ days in future
Continue button enables with valid future date
task_3_starts_from_pricing: 'Starts from' text visible on vehicle cards on booking page
'Starts from' text visible in payment summary
'Estimated Total' label in Review & Pay step
task_4_standard_class_rename: 'Standard Class' displayed in fleet section on homepage (was Economy)
'Standard Class' shown on booking page vehicle selection
'Standard Class' in Review & Pay vehicle summary
task_5_icons_outside_inputs: Green circular background with landing plane icon for pickup location
Red circular background with map pin icon for dropoff location
Amber circular background with calendar icon for pickup date
Blue circular background with clock icon for pickup time
task_6_phone_input_country_selector: Phone input with country code dropdown on passenger info step
Country dropdown shows flag emoji, country name, and dial code
Search by dial code works (e.g., '+44' filters to UK)
Country selection updates the input display
task_7_hero_image: New hero background image showing LHR airport with black sedan and UK flag

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 UI/UX improvements from the batch are complete and tested. Airport IATA search uses static data from /app/frontend/src/data/airports.js with 500+ airports. Phone input uses country data from PhoneInput.js component with auto-detection. 24-hour validation is implemented in HomePage.js. The booking flow works: Homepage -> Vehicle Selection -> Passenger Info (with phone selector) -> Review & Pay. Note: Continue button on homepage requires JavaScript click (force=True) due to z-index overlay.
